judge.method: self-judged visual inspection of the Chrome render; strict per-requirement pass/fail

requirements.text: Create a red, sporty car with a body, wheels, and windows.
requirements.note: A red coupe has a defined body, two wheels, and blue windows.

requirements.text: Draw a distinct circular hoop that is completely surrounded by jagged, irregular flames colored with reds, oranges, and yellows.
requirements.note: A distinct circular flaming hoop uses irregular pointed red, orange, and yellow flames.

requirements.text: Include a take-off ramp on the left side of the fiery ring and a landing ramp on the right side.
requirements.note: A take-off ramp is visible on the left, but the right side has no landing ramp.

requirements.text: Position the car in mid-air, with its front half having passed through the ring and its back half still inside the ring.
requirements.note: The airborne car's front half is left of the hoop while its rear half overlaps the hoop opening.

requirements.text: The car's rear wheels must be depicted as just having left the edge of the take-off ramp.
requirements.note: The rear wheels are not shown just departing from the ramp edge.

requirements.text: Add a ground surface below the entire jump setup.
requirements.note: A dark ground plane spans beneath the ramps and hoop.

requirements.text: Incorporate gray speed lines trailing behind the car to convey high speed.
requirements.note: The gray horizontal marks read as background structures, not speed lines trailing the car.

requirements.text: Add orange sparks where the car's tires last touched the take-off ramp.
requirements.note: The orange particles do not appear at a tire-to-ramp contact point.
